Read DICOM Segmentation Objects (dcmseg)

Source: R/rt_seg.R
read_dicom_seg.Rd

Reads a DICOM Segmentation (SEG) dataset, extracting segment descriptions (SegmentSequence (0062,0002)) and the binary/fractional 3D segmentation mask array.

Usage

read_dicom_seg(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a DICOM Segmentation file.

Value

A list of class "dicom_seg" containing segments (tibble of segment metadata) and mask (pixel/voxel mask array).

Examples

dcm_file <- system.file("extdata", "example.dcm", package = "dicomtk")
seg <- read_dicom_seg(dcm_file)
dim(seg$mask)
#> [1] 512 512
